comentarios: One male seen and heard, singing, pecking and resting in a tree of Ocotea sp in forest interior of premontane forest. It did short flies in the canopy (less one minute each fly).It remained mainly pecking on the trunk for insect larvae  and after feed it turns its head and It did these monotonous songs repeated in a sequence with different time intervals ( range between 1  and 5 min) , being this cut, the first song of this sequence. Look recordings XC405083 ; XC405084; XC405085 ; XC405086  and XC405087. Probably same individual as XC379657, but I'm not sure. Because this last one  was recorded 150 meters from this place.  Recording distance was 10 meters for this and all cuts. Recorder and microphone were on a tripod.
